description: This file defines the SwfClient class for AWS SDK's Simple Workflow Service (SWF), including method signatures for various SWF operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SwfClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon SWF, extending AwsClient, with methods for SWF operations.

methods.name: getWorkflowExecutionHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history of a workflow execution.

methods.name: getWorkflowExecutionHistoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the history of a workflow execution.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: pollForActivityTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously polls for an activity task.

methods.name: pollForDecisionTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously polls for a decision task.

methods.name: recordActivityTaskHeartbeat
methods.description: Records a heartbeat for an activity task.

methods.name: recordActivityTaskHeartbeatAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously records a heartbeat for an activity task.

methods.name: registerActivityTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a new activity type.

methods.name: registerWorkflowTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a new workflow type.

methods.name: requestCancelWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Requests cancellation of a workflow execution.

methods.name: requestCancelWorkflowExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously requests cancellation of a workflow execution.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskCanceled
methods.description: Responds to an activity task cancellation.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskCanceledAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously responds to an activity task cancellation.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskCompleted
methods.description: Responds to an activity task completion.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskCompletedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously responds to an activity task completion.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskFailed
methods.description: Responds to an activity task failure.

methods.name: respondActivityTaskFailedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously responds to an activity task failure.

methods.name: respondDecisionTaskCompleted
methods.description: Responds to a decision task completion.

methods.name: respondDecisionTaskCompletedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously responds to a decision task completion.

methods.name: signalWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Sends a signal to a workflow execution.

methods.name: signalWorkflowExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a signal to a workflow execution.

methods.name: startWorkflowExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a new workflow execution.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
